workspace.name: Heathrow Logistics & Airside Guarding Tender
workspace.notes: Airside security with strict Department for Transport (DfT) counter-terrorism pass requirements and high-frequency perimeter patrols.

documents.extractedSnippet: Invitation to tender for airside perimeter guarding and vehicle gate compliance at Heathrow Airport Terminals 2 & 5.
Pricing schedule with airside clearance wage rates, vehicle lease amortizations, and shift premiums.

requirements.originalText: All operational personnel must hold valid DfT Airside Security Passes and CTC/SC national security vetting prior to deployment.
requirements.aiInterpretation: Mandatory Counter-Terrorist Check vetting for 100% of staff. Vetting lead time is ~8 weeks and must be factored into mobilization timeline.
requirements.suggestedClarificationQuestion: Will Heathrow Airport sponsor the required DfT security clearances during the mobilization period, or must the Contractor hold existing cleared personnel?

clarifications.questionText: Will Heathrow Airport sponsor DfT airside security pass applications during the 60-day mobilization window?
clarifications.businessReason: Essential to prevent penalty deductions for unmanned airside gates on commencement date.

checklist.title: DfT Compliance & Airside Operating License
checklist.description: Submission of company airside security accreditation certificate.
